name: Jesse
overview: Jesse, the Bethlehemite, is a pivotal figure in God's sovereign plan for Israel's leadership, as seen when the LORD commands Samuel to anoint one of his sons as the future king, replacing Saul (1 Samuel 16:1-3). Samuel's visit to Jesse and his sons, conducted under the guise of a sacrifice, highlights the divine selection process that culminates in the anointing of David (1 Samuel 16:4-5). Jesse is also noted as the father of David and an ancestor of Jesus, establishing his significance in the Messianic lineage (Ruth 4:17).
